September 17, 1937
Mr. H. M. Bixby
Vice President for China
Pan American Airways Co.
Manila, Philippine Islands
Dear Mr. Bixby:
I enclose for your information and files copy of a memo-
randum dated September 8th which I have prepared here and which is
self-explanatory.
The memorandum attached thereto and dated August
25th is, as you will imediately perceive, a synthetic composition of
your memorandum of August 25th and your personal and confidential let-
ter of the same date, but with certain confidential, off-the-record,
and imaterial matter omnitted. My object was to have one memorandum
giving the record of the events leading up to your departure fron Chine
which would be in such form that it could be show to any interested
parties and form,
1l necessary, a part of a published or legal record.
I believe this memorandum will fill the purpose I have in mind but if
you have any conments to make, and particularly if you have any addi-
tions to incorporate, I would appreciate having them in the form of a
supplementary memorandum with no confidential material included which
could be attached to this as a part of the official record.
The mail was just received today with your letters B-1 to
B-21, ommitting B-2 and B-6 not received, and gives us more infornation
and a good deal of interesting comment but nothing which I think has to
be added.
The President has instructed me, with the Comptroller, to
prepare a statement showing as nearly as poseible the actual losses euf-
fered through our forced withdrawl fron China.
I find our last CNAC
statement is that for May and I do not suppose that a later statement
will be received. If you have or can obtain any data tending to reflect
the belance sheet for CNAC at a later date than that, we should like to
have it.
With regard to our PAA losses, we are having Mr. Nowlin prepare
a statement of all property in China fully owned by Pan Americen Airways
Il at a ister date any of
this property can be salvaged it can, of course, be checked off on this
list. I do not know in what manner we will present our claim for our
fair participation in the assets of CNAC at the time of our withdrawal,
